description: For either equality mode, complete native parameter \(R\), original term \(r\), and a supplied raw intuitionistic tree \(p:\Gamma\Rightarrow A\), recursion on that actual tree returns \(\mathcal T_{R,r}(p):\Gamma^{[R]}\Rightarrow F_R(A)\). It covers every native primitive constructor, renames \(R,r\) in protected branches, and introduces no classical step.
